scope: Read-only source and control-path audit of Mermaid Roshan's current 4x4 Opera career atlases for all 15 careers. No new runtime capture, motion score, generation request, or acceptance claim is made.

ordinary_playback.looping: All four requested-row cells loop indefinitely. At 7 fps, work repeats every 4/7 seconds (about 0.57 seconds).
ordinary_playback.phase_routing: Non-talk phases call work unless REVIEWED_WORK_POSES supplies a held row-2 cell; talk calls idle. Travel is requested while the world tween/path moves the TextureRect, then returns to idle.

code_proven_contract.held_pose_behavior: show_pose applies one cell, stops processing, and does not loop.
code_proven_contract.special_cheer_behavior: Ballerina, Geologist, and Teacher play all four cheer cells once at 2 fps and hold cell 3. Ordinary careers loop cheer at 6 fps unless the surrounding surface replaces or ends it.
code_proven_contract.ballerina_specialist_behavior: Pearl Mirror selects explicit work-row pose cells; Ribbon Trail changes pose by accepted progress bands. This is controlled pose selection, not row animation.
code_proven_contract.evidence_limit: These statements are code facts. They do not prove visual smoothness, stable pivots, semantic contact, child readability, or a visible settle.

cross_family_findings: No career has complete captured anticipation, action/contact, payoff, and settle coverage for every named phase.
Ordinary looping is code-proven for 12 families, but temporal quality is unproven; a coherent source row is only a candidate for its matching verb.
Doctor, Farmer, and Racer have bounded phase holds. Ballerina, Geologist, and Teacher have controller-level held states. These contain known pose-library problems but do not supply authored motion.
Magician and Nursery remain the clearest uncontained semantic substitution risks because unrelated effect/prop keys still loop for non-talk phases.
Reuse-first priority is to capture and route existing semantically correct cells/sequences. Generate or commission only a named missing verb after mounted evidence confirms the gap.
acceptance_limits: Existing probe evidence establishes state-control behavior, not visual motion acceptance.
No scores were assigned from unviewed motion and prior source-sheet scores were not promoted into this follow-up.
No target-device, observed-child, owner, full-game, or master-audit acceptance is claimed.
